name: crossing
description: The Crossing: three enemies, three weaknesses - a soaked machine across the abyss (jolt it, or mist and drop it), a stealthed wooden thing in the crypt (fire on the area, a wave or a vortex into the rift), a heavy boss on the brink (mist and knock it in, or haul it across; fire makes it cave the brink in); one skill each from six, eight pairs win
